question.text: Ms. Kavita Rao manages a legacy Venture Capital Fund registered under SEBI (VCF) Regulations, 1996 and wishes to migrate to the AIF Regulations as a 'Migrated Venture Capital Fund'. Per SEBI Circular dated June 6, 2025, the deadline for such migration with 2/3 investor consent is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/AFD/SEC-3/P/CIR2025/85 dated June 6, 2025: VCFs registered under SEBI (Venture Capital Funds) Regulations, 1996 that desire to migrate to SEBI (AIF) Regulations as 'Migrated Venture Capital Fund' may seek registration subject to approval of two-thirds of their investors by value of their investment WITHIN JULY 19, 2025. The Trap: The other date options are plausible near-terms but not the regulatory deadline. Migration failure means the VCF continues under old regime with restrictions on raising fresh commitments. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C covers the migration framework. This is a one-time regulatory transition analogous to mutual-fund merger schemes. Post-deadline, old VCFs finish existing mandates but cannot raise new corpus. Manager's Pro-Tip: For legacy VCFs, migration unlocks modern AI framework, LVF structures, and updated concentration caps. But the 2/3 LP consent vote is complex — pre-align with large LPs 3 months before the vote, prepare a comparison deck (old VCF Regs vs new AIF Regs), and disclose all consequential PPM amendments.
